name: Walk one prediction through the model
summary: A fixed three-token prompt passes through the repository's deterministic teaching model.

stages.title: Token IDs
stages.summary: The fixed prompt enters as three vocabulary IDs.

stages.title: Token embedding
stages.summary: The final token ID selects one learned embedding row.

stages.title: Causal attention
stages.summary: The final query mixes only its visible prefix positions.

stages.title: Residual stream
stages.summary: Attention is added to the selected embedding instead of replacing it.

stages.title: RMS normalisation
stages.summary: RMSNorm rescales the residual stream before prediction.

stages.title: Language-model head
stages.summary: The output projection produces one logit for each vocabulary token.
